answer: Existing source,occurrence evidence,typed copula,modifier,build-time relation and profile seams exist. In the inspected current consumer chain there is no completed source-warranted qualified-frame/domain plus canonical-pole channel that retains multiple fine dictionary identities. This identifies wiring boundaries only; it neither forbids justified contextual constraints nor supplies their warrant.

bringing about salvation or redemption from sin
marked by utter benignity; resembling or befitting an angel or saint

owner_recovery_contract_read_full: docs/program/LEXICON_CONSTRUCTION_DESIGN.md:Recovery contract — usable checkpoint and the SSL learning mechanism

facts: Encoder calls select for AMBIGUOUS non-grammatical NOUN/PROPN/VERB/ADJ/ADV or promoted predicates. Exact grammatical rows take their own eligibility path.
Only EXACT_WORDNET_SENSE causes an explicit dictionary entry selection and bank reload. Other grounding results remain contextual_grounding evidence beside the unresolved original candidate IDs.
This return handling has no current distinct frame-domain plus canonical-pole projection branch retaining multiple fine identities.
seams.name: contextual_grounding_entry

facts: Joins exact definition and same-entry WordNet observation; checks PARTIAL/RESOLVED status, POS compatibility, complete native ancestry identity and attested native lemma.
NativeSense retains synset,nodes,gloss,anchors,names,examples. It does not retain source native_relations,lexname,attribute targets,topic domains,pertainyms,or modifier-binding proof as typed fields.
seams.name: native_source_verification_and_field_reduction

facts: Primary frames are chart-pin checked and catalogue-linked; role substitutions require exact independently attested curated pronoun records and eligible grammar. Arbitrary nouns are not wildcard people.

A unique matched frame returns PRIMARY_FRAME_COMPATIBLE_NOT_IDENTIFYING,compatible_entry_id,identity_scope UNRESOLVED,missing_witness INDEPENDENT_MEANING_DISCRIMINATION,and unresolved_ordinary_entry_ids.
This is compatibility-only source evidence,not an independently warranted bank constraint or finer-sense selector. A morally qualified generic assertion is not supplied by this code.
seams.name: existing_primary_frame_warrant_boundary

facts: VERB/ADJ/ADV first use complete native-example construction matches; competing senses abstain. Only independently attested personal-subject substitution is allowed.
Qualifiers,arguments,valency and operators are not erased. Source examples are positive attestations,not exhaustive exclusion rules.
No adjective semantic-domain/attribute classifier is called on this branch; native nominal support is a different branch.
seams.name: non_nominal_exact_example_path

facts: Versioned runtime_lookup requires exactly one retained identity or an exact entry_id. More than one is AMBIGUOUS even for equal assignments.
_definition_evidence retains all candidates/domains but has no selected_record or primitives when selection is unresolved.
_lookup_lexeme returns empty word/sentence banks on non-IDENTIFIED selection (registered grammatical operator metadata can survive). For IDENTIFIED it emits stored nonzero assignments.

Thus occurrence word_primitives is the existing encoder/vector/profile value carrier,but an independently warranted coarse frame constraint without arbitrary fine ID has no separate admission branch here. No constraint is authorized by this audit.
seams.name: stored_identity_gate

facts: Copular nominal/adjective complements become TYPE_ASSERT unless event/spatial/relational adjective constructions take their existing branches.
An ADV+ADJ complement with no entity remains a Phrase of both content atoms. Their order and positions survive evaluation.
Entity.modifier is a single first ADJ/ADV compatibility axis when the phrase has an entity head; it is not a general qualified-predicate scope graph.

Atom copies word_primitives and grammatical metadata,not TokenTrace.lexical_evidence. TypeAssertion stores entity,kind,modal,duration only. No explicit source-bound semantic-domain/canonical-pole constraint field exists on these dataclasses.
seams.name: copula_and_modifier_structure

facts: Degree grammar binds supported INTENSITY adverbs and scoped signs without choosing lexical identity or creating a missing base. It does not bind arbitrary domain qualifiers such as morally.
Comparison/Equality/DegreeQuery can store axis,otherwise recover the first ADJ/ADV lemma; this is not a source-verified moral-domain assignment. TypeAssertion has no axis field.
seams.name: existing_orthogonal_modifier_and_axis_paths

facts: Actual path is enc.encode -> from_trace -> resolve_with_sources -> evaluate_tree -> deixis; profile consumes these events.
text_profile affect reads explicit GOOD/BAD on each content token.word_primitives; valence is GOOD minus BAD. With no qualifying tokens valence_mean is None,not zero.
It does not infer affect from TypeAssertion.kind,source gloss,Entity.type_thread,compatible_entry_id,or vector-probed activations. Primitive aggregation separately reads trace activations.

Consequently a future warranted tree-only frame constraint is not currently consumed by affect. A profile-only lookup would discard occurrence eligibility and is explicitly rejected by the existing profile test.
seams.name: real_document_profile_boundary

facts: Stored adjective native_relations preserves versioned similar_to,attributes and lemma-sense antonyms with full target definitions. Governing semantics is NATIVE_RELATIONS_NOT_LEXICAL_ASSIGNMENTS.
Adverb observations preserve native gloss/examples/lemma_names but this adapter does not export adverb pertainym or topic-domain links. Adjective topic_domains are also not exported here.

WordNetHierarchyEntry.lexname is called Semantic domain but adj.all/adv.all do not distinguish the inspected moral readings. get_domain(word) returns entries[0].lexname,not a contextual native sense; it is not called by encoder,lexical_grounding,or profile.
seams.name: source_relation_evidence_not_assignment

facts: Relation carries banks,allowed_rows,provenance,approval,guards,absent_evidence and propagation preserves joint support and typed conflicts. Unapproved/unknown or mismatched guards do not narrow.

Registered lexical contexts support POS,exact native lemma,ancestry/outside ancestry/other synset,explicit exceptions,and registered native noun/anatomy frames. No moral semantic-domain or sentence modifier-attachment guard is registered.

Real callers include build_dictionary,complete_dictionary,reviewed_patterns stage/replay,epoch _resolve,and validation _stored_context. Encoder does not call lexical_context or propagate on sentence occurrences. These are existing construction/replay seams,not an already wired qualified runtime frame calculus.
seams.name: build_time_constraint_seam_not_sentence_runtime_frame

facts: Definition-store GSEPipeline.encode_sentence delegates to the same GSEEncoder; it is not a second qualified-predicate resolver. Legacy non-definition branches exist but do not establish source-qualified frame constraints.

resolve_references annotates Entity IDs/type threads; the generic coherence selector reranks genealogy threads and can retain frequency-primary defaults. Exact lexical nominal grounding instead calls native_only=True after independent native witnesses. Neither path installs a qualified pole on an ambiguous ADJ occurrence.

Decoder AttributeExtraction derives polarity/intensity from numeric primitive activations; no source identity/domain/modifier warrant channel is returned. This is not an independent semantic warrant or an encoder-side coarse constraint path.
seams.name: second_consumer_paths_checked

source_evidence_boundary: Exact native glosses/edges nominate semantic review; neither raw gloss keywords nor attribute/similar/antonym edges authorize pole inheritance. morally has two native readings; no first-sense selection performed.
unavailable_fields_in_inspected_chain: No typed qualified_predicate/semantic_domain/meaning_form/frame_bank_constraint field on TokenTrace,Atom,Entity,TypeAssertion. TokenTrace.lexical_evidence is an extensible dict,not proof admission by itself.
No general source/type/domain-qualified ADV-to-ADJ binding field; degree/degree_modifier cover INTENSITY only. Phrase retains constituents but does not assert the domain relation.
No runtime NativeSense fields for native adjective attribute/similar/antonym edges despite their source observations being stored.
No distinct encoder output handling for constrained coarse bank meaning while fine identity is AMBIGUOUS.
No text_profile affect reader for tree-level qualified constraints.
